title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator
objectives: Explore burning and sustained-combustion conditions relevant to understanding flammability of condensed fuels in microgravity.
approach: Use gaseous fuels through a porous burner to emulate selected heat-transfer and burning features of solid/liquid fuels.
